thread:
emily_perf: kicked off cross-gpu attn kernel pass (flash_opt, flash_stream, paged_async, fused_tile) on H100/A100/L40S this morning. saw a weird KV-cache throughput cliff on H100 at batch=12 with seq<=128 when continuous batching is on. posting quick repro and notes.

dmitri_infra: can you paste the runner and env?

emily_perf: runner:
```
attn-bench --kernels flash_opt,flash_stream,paged_async,fused_tile \n  --gpus H100,A100,L40S --seq 32,64,128,512,2048 --batch 1,4,8,12,24 \n  --kv-cache true --continuous-batching true --iters 200
```
container: redwood/attn:ci-2026-03-16
CUDA: 12.2 cuDNN: 9.6

carla_ml: interesting. did you try toggling continuous-batching and kv independently?

emily_perf: yes. kv=true + cont_batch=true triggers cliff. flipping cont_batch=false restores expected throughput. kv=false is fine. CLI diff attached.

ben_r: what metrics? tokens/sec or samples/sec? p95?

emily_perf: mean tok/s and p95 latency. sample lines:
flash_stream,H100,64,12,true,22000,18
flash_opt,H100,64,12,true,15000,30
paged_async,H100,2048,1,true,2300,150
fused_tile,A100,128,24,true,8000,45

alice_s: do we see memcopy spikes or SM occupancy change?

emily_perf: yes, NVTX trace shows memcpy bursts right when throughput drops. SM occupancy drops ~15% and L2 miss climbs.

dmitri_infra: uploading nvprof: s3://redwood-perf/attn/1779002222/nvprof.tar.gz
trace id: trace-1779002222-h100

carla_ml: hypothesis: continuous batching path is concatenating KV pages in a layout incompatible with fused_tile's tile-size assumption, causing extra device->device memcpy. I'll add assertions in fused_tile for KV stride.

ben_r: we should also add a small regression in CI that runs batch=12 seq=64 on H100 to catch this.

emily_perf: agree. I'll add the CI job and include a fast fallback: if cont_batch && batch>=12 && kernel==fused_tile then avoid fused_tile.

dmitri_infra: repro note: the regression only appears on certain driver builds. I'm repro'ing on two H100 hosts now.

perf-bot: perf-run queued: 1779002222-followup (priority: high). results will be posted to #eng-runtime

alice_s: can someone capture outputs for seed=99 to verify numerical parity? We need to ensure fallback doesn't change outputs.

emily_perf: did a seed=99 check: outputs match within fp16 tol for short seqs; long seqs diverge by 1-2 tokens due to accumulation differences. flagged in ticket PERF-3421.

carla_ml: I'll instrument fused_tile to log KV pointers and page boundaries when batch>=8.

dmitri_infra: nvprof logs uploaded, will follow up with driver matrix.

ben_r: adding CI test, will gate on perf-run results.

emily_perf: next sync tomorrow 11am to decide rollouts. thanks all.

alice_s: +1

emily_perf: closing thread for now — will update when traces processed. :white_check_mark:
